newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nellcor Puritan a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nellcor Puritan a buy.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Parice Halbert said Tuesday she initiated coverage of Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc with a buy rating.
-- She said the stock is trading about 14 times calendar 1998 with an outlook for 20 percent earnings growth.
-- The 18- to 24-month price target is $31 to $34 a share.
-- Shares were up 1/8 at 23-1/8 in afternoon trade.
-- Earnings for the second quarter ended in December -- estimated at $0.30 a share, flat with a year ago -- will be a low point for the company after absorbing major acquisitions.
-- She estimates full-year 1997 earnings at $1.30 a share, compared with $1.27 in 1996.
-- In the care of respiratory-impaired patients, Nellcor Puritan is a global provider with over 30 percent of its reveneus derived outside the United States.

-- She added the company's most pronounced growth is expected to result from international markets where it is actively expanding its presence. In fiscal 1997, sales growth is projected at 12 percent outside the United States and seven percent in the United States.
-- "With several new companies on its books, (Nellcor Puritan) is actively working to realize the full synergies of its many acquisitions," she wrote in a report.
